requirements.name: AI / LLM Evaluation and Model Assurance
requirements.reason: The shipped Shopify app manages merchant fields, values, imports and typed Liquid rendering without an AI/LLM/RAG decision path. AI used to develop source does not make product behavior an AI runtime.

requirements.name: User Research, Problem Validation and UX Validation
requirements.reason: User design feedback and beginner task documentation exist. Actual merchant task observation and authenticated usability acceptance are still required.
blocking_findings: Authenticated merchant task and actual screenshot evidence pending.

requirements.name: Product Analytics and Outcome Evidence
requirements.reason: Outcome metrics need a privacy-bounded definition and verified baseline; deployment/test counts do not prove merchant activation or conversion.
blocking_findings: Instrumentation/actual task-completion and adoption outcome evidence pending.

requirements.name: Experimentation and Hypothesis Lifecycle
requirements.reason: No A/B or paid-plan conversion experiment is authorized or selected; optional experiments must not block basic implementation.

requirements.name: Progressive Delivery and Feature Safety
requirements.reason: Exact-source isolated staging releases passed. Progressive main/live rollout and current release-candidate stop/rollback acceptance remain separate.

requirements.name: AI-Generated Engineering Quality and Maintainability Review
requirements.reason: Authorized source self-review and deterministic/service checks exist; final release review and applicable browser/theme/performance evidence remain pending.
blocking_findings: No independent release review or full browser acceptance certified.

requirements.name: Responsible AI and Human Oversight
requirements.reason: The product makes no AI-driven eligibility, employment, lending, healthcare or other high-impact automated decisions. Development-agent permissions stay governed separately.

requirements.name: Privacy, Regulatory and Compliance Evidence
requirements.reason: Shop sessions, merchant values and Shopify mandatory privacy webhooks require verified engineering privacy controls. Enqueue success is not signed-delivery receipt or a legal compliance conclusion.
blocking_findings: Signed compliance webhook receipt verification and applicable human privacy/retention review pending.

requirements.name: Architecture Decision Records
requirements.reason: Existing accepted ownership/access ADR is durable, while architecture registry proposals need reconciliation to implemented decisions and final acceptance.
blocking_findings: Architecture registry proposals have not been fully reconciled or acceptance-certified.

requirements.name: AI Asset and Configuration Registry
requirements.reason: No behavior-producing model, prompt, embedding or retrieval configuration ships in this conventional Shopify application. Git/source and normal API contracts identify product behavior.

requirements.name: Compatibility, Deprecation and End-of-Life Management
requirements.reason: Node22.13..<23, pinned Admin API2026-07 and exact dependency locks are enforced. Formal support/EOL review and notification ownership are not fully recorded.
blocking_findings: Upstream support/EOL monitoring and owner assignment pending; no removal dates invented.

requirements.name: Operational Runbooks and Resilience Drills
requirements.reason: Existing production rollback certification and feature staging guards are recorded. Feature-specific recovery runbooks are added; provider restore/outage drills are not claimed.
blocking_findings: Current feature provider backup/restore and outage drill evidence pending.

requirements.name: Tamper-Evident Audit Journal
requirements.reason: GitHub PR/CI/release identities are reconstructable. A policy template does not certify a signed append-only external privileged audit journal.
blocking_findings: Tamper-evident privileged audit runtime certification pending.

requirements.name: Unified Risk and Exception Register
requirements.reason: Production subscription/rollback and protected-data risks are recorded with pending acceptance. They must remain open until real mitigations/owners and applicable release checks are verified.
blocking_findings: Actual release risk-owner assignment and residual-risk disposition pending.

rules: A passed state requires project-specific evidence and a verified repository/runtime reference.
not_applicable requires a non-empty project-specific reason.
A blueprint or policy file is never pass evidence.
Blocking findings must be cleared or explicitly risk-accepted through normal authenticated consent before release where policy permits.
Requirements 89-96 use the same evidence rule as Requirements 83-88: policy presence alone is never pass evidence.
Expired risk/compliance/decision evidence must be reconciled before relying on it for release or privileged automation.
